title: Framed Vintage Style Oil Painting Print – Elegant Woman in White Dress
descriptionText:
Bring timeless elegance to your home with this beautiful framed artwork. This piece features a captivating portrait of a young woman in a flowing white dress, seated gracefully with a serene expression. The soft pastel tones and impressionistic brushwork create a romantic, dreamy atmosphere. A bouquet of colorful flowers in the background adds vibrancy and charm.
Perfect for a bedroom, living room, or study, this painting exudes both sophistication and warmth.
Condition: Excellent pre-owned condition. Frame and canvas show minimal to no signs of wear (see photos for details).
Style: Romantic / Impressionist
Medium: Oil on canvas (print, not an original hand-painted work)
Frame Color: White
